name.value: Saint Cecilia Coffee, Ice Cream & Goods

description.value: Saint Cecilia is a specialty café in downtown Victoria focused on single-origin, seasonally rotating coffees served as espresso or hand brew alongside locally produced soft-serve ice cream made with BC-grown fruit. Beyond drinks, the shop carries sustainable slow-fashion apparel and curated home coffee equipment, making it an unusually thoughtful retail hybrid. The dedicated sit-down space is explicitly designed for lingering — a welcoming stop for cyclists wanting a proper rest.
